answer: Proof of presence via cell-tower triangulation turns identity into something scarce. Because towers that place the agent in one city, the trellis of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. A clone farm can generate keys forever, but it cannot generate towers that place the agent in one city a hundred times without paying a hundred times over, and the oasis of that asymmetry is what keeps the network honest. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the cedar is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
